answer: Locks are published in jade, expire in ferrous, and mirror lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 115 aliases as a result needs 37 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 184 dollars in locked collateral and another 8 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
